statement: A proper flat torus torsor over a punctured bidisc with smooth total space and a smooth Jacobian over the full bidisc extends as a smooth torsor
depends_on: Hartogs extension; complete commuting fields; compact averaging; holomorphic Frobenius and finite transverse germ
notes: Root proof; E and D full-source referee PASS. Explicit good-Jacobian hypothesis is essential. No general purity theorem or Kahler assumption is used.

statement: In a one-sided smooth specialization the central critical values are exactly the labelled limits; a collapsed target gives an isotrivial torus fibration with at most two critical values
depends_on: E.2.7; E.2.10; E.2.11; exact ordinary and finite-root period models
notes: Root and D full-source referee PASS. Finite-root constant images give abelian surfaces; an ordinary constant image need not. Cusp constant image is excluded. Does not prove uniqueness of the interior completion.
